theorem.ambient: Simple compact acute-angled hyperbolic polytope; in particular a compact Coxeter polytope.
theorem.ports: A d-simplex face through a vertex selects its d incident edge ports.
theorem.intersection: Distinct maximal simplex faces have port-set intersection of size at most1, by unique maximal-simplex extension of each triangular two-face.
theorem.clique: For U of size u and k with2k-u>=2, at most one maximal-simplex port block B with |B|>=k and B subset U occurs.
theorem.orbit_average: Average the clique indicator over the full labelled-diagram automorphism orbit of U; its total at every vertex remains at most1.
theorem.completeness: The theorem concerns every maximal simplex, without an observed dimension or label cutoff. The diagnostic tests only the frozen dual and three small (u,k) clique types.

arithmetic: Exact Fraction arithmetic; canonical marked-tree graphs from a bound frozen helper. No optimizer and no new spherical or arithmetic-star census.

fixed_face_mass_consequence.scope: Necessary only for realization with these exact fixed face masses. Increasing vertex masses is not asserted sufficient for a realizable distribution.

successor_scope: Every old face and budget remains. These22 valid clique charges strengthen the partial model; no augmented optimization, feasible rule, complete face coverage or dimension bound is claimed.
diagnosis: The frozen dual certifies an obstruction to its pair-charge model, but its face/vertex masses violate actual maximal-simplex incidence. The contradiction is to that hypothetical global incidence distribution, not to the arithmetic validity of any individual local star.
